stage_a_additions.source_quote: L’applicazione del Ribess+ prevede una metodologia ad uno step con la quale si definisce il numero di piante da campionare nell’area interessata. La dimensione del campione all’interno delle aree da sottoporre a sorveglianza è determinata applicando 2 livelli di rischio: Alto (valore 2) e Base (valore 1). Tabular scope transcription: high relative risk 2; base relative risk 1. Pest-free high-risk zone: 1 km outside the buffer boundary. Delimited high-risk rings: 400 m wide, starting at the 50 m radius around previous-campaign infected plants. ST53 buffer also includes the 400 m interface strip. Source §4.1.1 additionally identifies intervening pest-free territory and allocation factors; two equal risk numbers do not erase overlapping geographic qualifications.

dispositions.expression: L’applicazione del Ribess+ prevede una metodologia ad uno step con la quale si definisce il numero di piante da campionare nell’area interessata. La dimensione del campione all’interno delle aree da sottoporre a sorveglianza è determinata applicando 2 livelli di rischio: Alto (valore 2) e Base (valore 1). Tabular scope transcription: high relative risk 2; base relative risk 1. Pest-free high-risk zone: 1 km outside the buffer boundary. Delimited high-risk rings: 400 m wide, starting at the 50 m radius around previous-campaign infected plants. ST53 buffer also includes the 400 m interface strip. Source §4.1.1 additionally identifies intervening pest-free territory and allocation factors; two equal risk numbers do not erase overlapping geographic qualifications.
dispositions.why: One step and two risk levels describe model composition; previous-campaign qualification and allocation factors remain semantic population inputs. Independently minted magnitudes resolve through their own source phrases.
